name: Shake
storyline:
A single salmon spent its days roaming the ocean, waiting for the day it would return upstream.

But one day, its fate was cut short far too easily. A violent pull, a white deck—and then… darkness.

When it awoke,this place was neither ocean nor river.

Under cold, artificial light stood a transparent display case. Its body was no longer a single fish—it had been packaged as a fillet.

To the left and right, piles of identical fillets. No matter how much it called out, none responded. They were nothing more than “products,” unable to move or think.

—Why am I the only one?

With an unanswered question in its mind, the salmon tears through the plastic wrap and leaps out of the case.

Even though its body is now just a fillet, the memory of upstream migration remains.

To return to its birthplace—the river. The salmon’s migration begins once again, right here.
summary:
“Shake” is an action game where players control a slice of salmon and aim to reach the goal.
The game features physics-based movement, where the character easily rolls, requiring players to carefully manage jumps, balance, and positioning.

Players can use a “freshness” gauge to stick to walls and floors, helping stabilize movement. Mastering both careful control and bold decision-making is key to reaching the goal.
